description: Variation of condition 5 (hours of operation) to allow the hours of operation to be Monday to Friday 16:30 - 20:45, Saturday 07:45 - 20:45, Sundays and Bank Holidays 08:00 - 17:30 of planning permission 00553/J/P8 approved 26/06/2019 for the change of use of second floor of Bridge House to educational tuition centre (use class D1)
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the 07/06/2019 (the date of the granting of 00553/J/P18).

Condition : 2 - 2.	The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Planning Statement April 2019, Second Floor Plan 14.02.2019, Existing Second Floor Layout Plan 14-136-03, received 15/04/2019 and unnumbered Location Plan, Parking Area to be controlled by Accelerated Education Tuition Ltd AET/P/MWP, TPS Travel Plan dated July 2019, Cover Letter dated 21st July 2019, Statement in support of Section 73 Application dated April 2019; received 23/07/2019) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - Prior to first beneficial use of the development hereby approved a Final Travel Plan shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The proposed use shall operate in accordance with the approved plan thereafter.

Condition : 4 - The premises shall be used for an educational tuition centre and for no other purpose (including any other purpose in Class D1 of the Schedule to the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987, or in any provision equivalent to that Class in any statutory instrument revoking and re-enacting that Order with or without modification).

Condition : 5 - The education tuition purposes use hereby permitted shall only be carried out between the following times Monday to Friday 16:30 - 20:45, Saturday 07:45 - 20:45, Sundays and Bank Holidays 08:00 - 17:30.

Condition : 6 - No part of the development shall be occupied until full details (including manufacturers specifications) of secure covered cycle parking facilities for the occupants of, and visitors to, the development have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The approved facilities shall conform to current guidance such as the TfL London Cycling Design Standards in design and layout and be fully implemented and be made available for use before the first occupation of the development and thereafter retained for use at all times without obstruction.
